title: License Management
text:
Breadcrumbs
As a Leapwork user, your license type (Trial, Platform, or Enterprise License) determines your access to the Leapwork Automation Platform.
Note:
License Management settings are available if you are logged in as an administrator. For more information, please refer to
licenses and deployment
.
All licenses are installed on the
Controller
using
Flow
as the interface. For installation and activation details, see the
Download and Installation Guides
.
License Types:
Trial License
: Short-term, limited feature access for evaluation.
Platform License
: For teams needing to collaborate on designing, maintaining, and running automation flows.
Enterprise License
: For large-scale deployments requiring all the features.
One controller will be associated with one license.
The active license configuration can be found in
License Management
under the
Settings
section.
Add License
The
Add a License
button is disabled when the customer's
license is active
. When the current license expires, the button will be enabled, allowing the purchase of a new license.
This ensures a seamless transition and continuous use of the product without interruptions.
Refresh License
Refreshing the license updates changes such as adjustments to the number of users, agents,
AI Blocks
, or
Cloud Blocks
. This process grants access to important features, ensuring the correct configuration and optimal performance of your Leapwork platform.
To refresh:
Click the
Refresh License
button.
Click
Refresh
.
Note:
When Customer Support requests a license refresh, it is essential to follow their instructions.
Deactivate License
You can deactivate a license to migrate the license to another
Controller
machine.
To deactivate:
Click the
Deactivate License
button.
Click
Deactivate
.
Note:
If the last active license is removed from a
Controller
, you must add a new license before it becomes accessible.
